description: 这件中国瓷茶壶约制于1643年。馆方记录其来自一艘约于1643年沉没的中国帆船；壶身与壶盖保留青花装饰。
imageAlt: 青花瓷茶壶（约1643年） / Teapot — c. 1643
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Leo A. and Doris Hodroff

description: 约1752年制作的中国瓷茶壶。馆方将其置于荷兰东印度公司贸易与 Geldermalsen 沉船所见外销瓷的历史背景中介绍。
imageAlt: 青花瓷茶壶（约1752年） / Teapot — c. 1752
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Leo A. and Doris Hodroff

description: 这件小型瓷茶壶约制于1643年，壶身以青花装饰，配有壶盖、侧把与壶流。现藏于明尼阿波利斯艺术馆。
imageAlt: 青花瓷茶壶（约1643年） / Teapot — c. 1643
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Leo A. and Doris Hodroff

description: 约1720年的瓷茶壶，壶流为后来补配的银件。馆方认为原瓷流可能在运输途中损坏；这种修补反映中国外销瓷在使用者心中的珍贵价值。
imageAlt: 银流修补瓷茶壶 / Make-do teapot — c. 1720
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Christopher Monkhouse and Catherine Futter in honor of Leo and Doris Hodroff

titleChinese: 宜兴紫砂泥绘山水茶壶
description: 约1800年制作的宜兴茶壶，以泥绘表现渔人、树木、亭阁与远山。馆方将作者记为Hsu Shun-fang，并记录了壶底的印款。
imageAlt: 宜兴紫砂泥绘山水茶壶 / Teapot — c. 1800
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

titleChinese: 铜胎掐丝珐琅龙纹茶壶
description: 馆方定为17至18世纪的铜与珐琅茶壶。绿色珐琅地以细金属丝组织龙与云纹，壶盖亦饰龙纹；馆方认为它属于富裕家庭的日用器。
imageAlt: 铜胎掐丝珐琅龙纹茶壶 / Teapot — 17th-18th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

description: 1839年制作的宜兴茶壶，馆方归于Ch'u Ying-shao。壶形借鉴旧式石权，短直流、曲柄与平盖相配，侧面刻有诗文，壶底见方形印款。
imageAlt: 宜兴紫砂诗文茶壶 / Teapot — 1839
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

description: 18世纪晚期的中国施釉瓷茶壶。白色壶身饰釉彩纹章，壶盖、壶流和侧把共同构成完整器形；现藏于明尼阿波利斯艺术馆。
imageAlt: 釉彩纹章瓷茶壶 / Teapot — late 18th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of C. Curtis Dunnavan

description: 18世纪晚期的中国施釉瓷茶壶。白色壶身上的纹章与壶把、壶盖的彩饰相呼应；馆藏编号为2014.56.5a, b。
imageAlt: 釉彩纹章瓷茶壶 / Teapot — late 18th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of C. Curtis Dunnavan

description: 约1754年的中国瓷茶壶，馆方题名明确记载其装饰为船舶场景。船只图像与茶壶器形结合，展现18世纪茶器装饰中的海洋题材。
imageAlt: 帆船图瓷茶壶 / Teapot with scenes of ships — c. 1754
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Leo and Doris Hodroff

description: 17世纪中晚期的小型宜兴茶壶，馆方作者归属为Liu P'ei。朱红色壶身刻有诗句与署名，壶底与盖内留有印款。
imageAlt: 宜兴紫砂小茶壶 / Miniature Teapot — mid to late 17th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

description: 约1750年的中国瓷茶壶，馆方将其称为“Cadogan”式茶壶。圆润壶身、曲线壶流和环形侧把构成独特轮廓。
imageAlt: 卡多根式瓷茶壶 / “Cadogan” teapot — c. 1750
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Leo A. and Doris Hodroff

titleChinese: 欧洲式帆船与商船图瓷茶壶
titleEnglish: Teapot with quasi-European ship and chop boat
description: 约1730年的中国瓷茶壶。馆方题名指出其描绘近似欧洲式船只与中国商船（chop boat），记录18世纪海上贸易语境中的船舶图像。
imageAlt: 欧洲式帆船与商船图瓷茶壶 / Teapot with quasi-European ship and chop boat — c. 1730
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Leo and Doris Hodroff

description: 18世纪晚期的宜兴茶壶，将壶身塑成捆束的竹段，壶流、侧把与盖钮呼应竹枝形态。浅色胎上点洒褐色泥浆，模拟斑竹肌理。
imageAlt: 宜兴紫砂束竹式茶壶 / Tea Pot — late 18th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. The Suzanne S. Roberts Fund for Asian Art

materialEnglish:
Jizhou ware
Stoneware with brown glaze to the exterior with papercut decoration reserved in dark brown against a variegated buff ground on the interior
description: 12至13世纪的吉州窑茶盏，外壁施褐釉，内壁以剪纸贴花形成深色纹样，与斑驳的浅褐釉地相对照。
imageAlt: 吉州窑剪纸贴花茶盏 / Tea Bowl — 12th-13th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

materialEnglish:
Jizhou ware
Stoneware with brown glaze
description: 馆方定为11至12世纪、北宋时期的吉州窑茶盏，材质为施褐釉的炻器。内壁釉色与朴素器形构成茶盏的视觉特色。
imageAlt: 吉州窑褐釉茶盏 / Tea Bowl — 11th-12th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. The Ruth Ann Dayton Chinese Room Endowment Fund

titleChinese: 吉州窑剪纸凤梅纹茶盏
materialEnglish:
Jizhou ware
Buff colored stoneware with brown glaze on the exterior and papercut decoration reserved in dark brown glaze against a variegated buff ground on the inside
description: 12至13世纪的吉州窑茶盏。馆方将内壁装饰称为凤梅纹，采用剪纸模板形成抗釉纹样，使凤鸟与梅枝显现在斑驳釉地之上。
imageAlt: 吉州窑剪纸凤梅纹茶盏 / Tea Bowl — 12th-13th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

materialEnglish:
Jian ware
Stoneware with black glaze and russet-colored markings
description: 12至13世纪的茶盏，馆方将其材质记为建窑黑釉炻器，釉面带赤褐色纹理；时代字段归入金代。现藏于明尼阿波利斯艺术馆。
imageAlt: 建窑黑釉茶盏 / Tea bowl — 12th-13th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Alfred F. Pillsbury

materialEnglish:
Cizhou ware
Stoneware with tortoiseshell glaze
description: 馆方定为11世纪、北宋时期的磁州窑茶盏，以深色釉与浅色斑纹形成玳瑁釉效果。现藏于明尼阿波利斯艺术馆。
imageAlt: 磁州窑玳瑁釉茶盏 / Tea bowl — 11th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Gene Quintana

materialEnglish:
Jizhou ware
Stoneware with black glaze and slip-decorated prunus branch and moon motif
description: 10至11世纪的吉州窑茶盏。黑釉内壁以泥浆装饰梅枝与月亮纹样，将花木题材融入茶器的观看体验。
imageAlt: 吉州窑梅枝月纹茶盏 / Tea bowl — 10th-11th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

titleChinese: 河南窑黑釉铁锈斑茶盏
materialEnglish:
Henan ware
Stoneware with black glaze and iron-splashed markings
description: 12至13世纪的河南窑茶盏，馆方材质说明为黑釉炻器，并记有铁质斑纹装饰。内壁深色釉面与褐色斑纹相互映衬。
imageAlt: 河南窑黑釉铁锈斑茶盏 / Tea bowl — 12th-13th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of funds from Clifford and Suzanne Roberts

materialEnglish:
Ding ware
Porcelain with incised lotus decor under clear glaze
description: 11世纪的定窑瓷茶碗，透明釉下刻划莲花装饰。细密纹样与柔和的白色瓷面相配，呈现宋代白瓷茶器的素雅气质。
imageAlt: 定窑刻莲纹白瓷茶碗 / Tea bowl — 11th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

materialEnglish:
Cizhou ware
Stoneware with brown and white slip under clear glaze
description: 12世纪的磁州窑茶盏，馆方时代记为北宋或金代。褐色与白色泥浆装饰覆以透明釉，形成内外壁的色彩对比。
imageAlt: 磁州窑褐白釉茶盏 / Tea bowl — 12th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Louis W. Hill, Jr.

materialEnglish:
Jian ware
Dark-brown stoneware with dark-brown glaze and iron oxide markings
description: 12至13世纪的建窑茶盏，深褐色胎釉上带铁氧化物形成的纹理。馆方介绍其兔毫纹与宋代白色点茶的使用背景。
imageAlt: 建窑兔毫茶盏 / Tea Bowl (yan-kou wan) — 12th-13th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

titleChinese: 耀州窑柿色釉茶碗与盏托
materialEnglish:
Yaozhou ware
Stoneware with persimmon glaze
description: 10至11世纪的耀州窑茶碗与盏托，馆方以成组器物编目，照片展示茶碗。浅腹茶碗施柿色釉，卷曲口沿与温暖的赤褐釉面相映。
imageAlt: 耀州窑柿色釉茶碗与盏托 / Tea Bowl and Stand — 10th-11th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

materialEnglish:
Chi-chou ware
Stoneware with brown glaze to the exterior with papercut decoration reserved in dark brown against a variegated buff ground on the interior
description: 12至13世纪的吉州窑茶盏，馆方以旧式拼写Chi-chou记录窑口。褐釉外壁与内壁的剪纸贴花装饰，展现深色茶盏的纹饰工艺。
imageAlt: 吉州窑剪纸贴花茶盏 / Tea Bowl — 12th-13th century
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Ruth and Bruce Dayton

materialEnglish: Stoneware with splashed markings in brown tortoiseshell glaze
description: 南宋时期的施釉炻器茶盏，深褐釉面洒落浅色斑纹，形成玳瑁釉效果。中文题名依据馆方材质说明，不额外推定窑口。
imageAlt: 玳瑁釉茶盏 / Tea bowl — Southern Song (1127–1279)
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Bequest of Ruth Stricker Dayton

description: 约1775年的中国瓷茶碗，馆方记录为釉上彩装饰瓷器。碗壁绘有山水景物，细线描绘与白色瓷地形成清晰对比。
imageAlt: 釉彩山水纹瓷茶碗 / Tea bowl — c. 1775
creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. Gift of Louise J. Drews in memory of her parents Margaret and Carson Jamieson

titleChinese: 耀州窑刻莲纹青瓷茶碗
materialEnglish:
Yaozhou ware (Northern celadon)
Porcelaneous stoneware with carved and incised lotus decor under green glaze

creditLine: Minneapolis Institute of Art. The Ethel M. VanDerlip Fund

description: 12世纪的施釉炻器茶盏。馆方以天目茶盏的传播为背景介绍其锥形碗身、小圈足和深色釉面，未明确标注具体窑口。

materialEnglish:
